speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: asked the Minister for National Development in each of the last five years (a) how many Singaporeans aged below 35 who are married to foreigners who are not Long-Term Visit Pass holders made appeals to buy HDB flats or rent flats under the Public Rental Scheme; (b) how many appeals were approved; and (c) what were the main reasons for approval or denial.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: If the SC is a First-Timer aged 35 and above, the couple can also buy a new 2-room Flexi flat in the non-mature estates from HDB, in addition to the resale options I explained earlier.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: That notwithstanding, HDB assesses all requests holistically and exercises flexibility for those in exceptional circumstances with no other housing options or family support.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: This number includes couples where the foreign spouse had a LTVP, as HDB does not track the number of such couples with or without LTVP.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: HDB carefully assesses each appeal based on the household's unique circumstances, taking into account factors such as housing needs, financial conditions, family circumstances and medical conditions.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: I just want to understand why is it that the Family Scheme under HDB does not include spouses with LTVP who are LTVP holders.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: Because LTVP is similar to SPR in many ways – as far as healthcare is concerned, they get similar kinds of benefits.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: So, why do they not get the same kind of housing benefits that SPRs get?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, basically, it is about how we prioritise resources.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We also work with the residents to see how they can have that housing option.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: While we move forward, I hope that Members would also understand the situation that we are facing, where we want to balance the needs of our citizens and at the same time, we also want to make sure that there are opportunities for parenthood and provide housing options for Singaporeans, whatever circumstances they are in, and also provide help for those who are in dire need.
